subject.title: [Feature]: Cost metadata support for auto-discovered Amazon Bedrock models

question: Should Bedrock discovery pricing be added as a plugin-local discovery config overlay, a general models-level cost overlay, or not added beyond explicit provider model entries?
rationale: This adds a user-facing config/API surface in an area where repository policy sets a high bar and the old models.bedrockDiscovery path has moved into plugin-owned config.

options.title: Plugin-local discovery overlay
options.body: Add pricing under plugins.entries.amazon-bedrock.config.discovery so Bedrock owns the provider-specific config surface and core stays lean.

options.title: General models cost overlay
options.body: Add a broader models-level overlay that can patch any discovered provider model, accepting the larger config/API contract.

options.title: Keep explicit provider entries only
options.body: Do not add discovery pricing metadata and require users to configure explicit models.providers entries for local cost estimates.

recommendation.title: Plugin-local discovery overlay
recommendation.body: Add pricing under plugins.entries.amazon-bedrock.config.discovery so Bedrock owns the provider-specific config surface and core stays lean.

likelyOwner.reason: The current plugin-owned discovery config and migration boundary are tied to steipete’s recent history, making this the strongest routing owner for the API-shape decision.
